description: The plot illustrates how two metrics, Recall@50 and NDCG@50, vary with an integer x-axis setting for two methods (“Ours” and “ReFICR”), with Recall@50 shown on the left y-axis and NDCG@50 on the right y-axis. The x-axis is unlabeled, uses a linear scale, and runs from 1 to 5 with ticks at each integer. The left y-axis is labeled “Recall@50,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.30 to 0.60 with regularly spaced tick labels at 0.05 intervals. The right y-axis is labeled “NDCG@50,” uses a linear scale, and spans approximately 0.15 to 0.22 with tick labels at 0.01 intervals. For Recall@50, a green solid line with circular markers (“Recall@50 (Ours)”) increases across x, starting near 0.35 at x=1, rising to about 0.43 at x=2, about 0.47 at x=3, about 0.48 at x=4, and about 0.49 at x=5; a green dotted horizontal line (“Recall@50 (ReFICR)”) stays constant at roughly 0.47 across all x values. For NDCG@50, a blue solid line with square markers (“NDCG@50 (Ours)”) increases from about 0.16 at x=1 to about 0.18 at x=2, about 0.185 at x=3, and about 0.19 at x=4, remaining around 0.19 at x=5; a blue dotted horizontal line (“NDCG@50 (ReFICR)”) remains constant at approximately 0.155 across the full x-axis range.
